Privacy

Privacy

Last updated 28 September 2026

The short version

The current Local LLM Finder code does not add advertising, analytics, accounts or tracking cookies. Your hardware and task selections are processed in your browser by the tool. If you use the share-link feature, the setup is encoded after the # in the URL; that fragment is normally handled by the browser rather than sent as part of the HTTP request.

Hosting logs

The service used to host this website may process ordinary technical information needed to serve the site, such as IP address, browser information, request time and requested pages. Those hosting practices are controlled by the hosting provider, not by the calculator code itself.

External links

The site may link to third-party services and model publishers. If you follow those links, their own privacy policies and data practices apply.

If the site changes

If analytics, advertising, accounts or other data-collecting features are added later, this page should be updated before or when those features are enabled. Consent controls may also be required for some visitors depending on the technologies used and where visitors are located.
